canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Mortgage Research Center denied {value} of its 4,160 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Mortgage Research Center decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Mortgage Research Center will deny any specific future application with 36.2% probability
Mortgage Research Center is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Mortgage Research Center discriminates or violates law
36.2% applies to Mortgage Research Center's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
